description: WhatsApp Flows: forms people fill in without leaving the chat (sign-up, booking, lead capture, survey). action "list" or "get" (with a preview link). "create" makes a DRAFT from name, categories (SIGN_UP, SIGN_IN, APPOINTMENT_BOOKING, LEAD_GENERATION, CONTACT_US, CUSTOMER_SUPPORT, SURVEY, OTHER) and flowJson (Meta's Flow JSON, ≤10 MB), or cloneFlowId. "update" changes a DRAFT (name, categories, flowJson, endpointUri). Meta's validation errors come back verbatim. "publish" is FINAL (a published form cannot be changed or deleted, only deprecated), "deprecate" stops it being sent, "delete" removes a draft: these three need confirm:true after a first call without it. "versions" (flowId): Hermoso's record of a form's copies and changes (Meta keeps no history). "encryption_key" / "set_encryption_key" (phoneNumberId, publicKey: your 2048-bit RSA PUBLIC key in PEM, confirm:true): what a form that calls your own server (data_exchange) needs before it can be published. Send a form with send_whatsapp_message interactive { type: "flow", flowId, flowCta } (mode "draft" to test); answers arrive in read_whatsapp_inbox. 0 credits.

cloneFlowId.description: create: start as a copy of this form

confirm.description: true to publish, deprecate or delete, after the user said yes

endpointUri.description: only for a form that calls your own server (data_exchange)

flowJson.description: the Flow JSON object ({ version, screens: [...] }) or that JSON as a string

publicKey.description: set_encryption_key: PEM public key, never the private key

wabaId.description: optional when exactly one account is shared with this profile
